name: Confidence Queen
description: Three con artists with different backgrounds, team up for a daring and adventurous scheme of revenge against the villains of this era.

videos.title: Speed Dial 0
videos.overview: Yi-rang, James, and Gu-ho take down another villain. Out of nowhere, Gu-ho announces he's leaving the con game and walking away from the team.

videos.title: Sand Foundation
videos.overview: Yi-rang and Gu-ho head to the Philippines to avenge James, who's in a coma. Tae-su blocks land and sea. Their only chance now is an aerial attack!

videos.title: Déjà Vu
videos.overview: Gu-ho discovers a hidden side of Mr. Famous, the hottest name in art criticism. But strangely, Yi-rang seems reluctant to join the con.

videos.title: Ghost Castle
videos.overview: A painting finally sees the light of day, stirring up chaos at an auction. Meanwhile, Yi-rang slips away alone, chasing traces of a buried memory.

videos.title: Atmos Black Noir
videos.overview: After a nightmare, Gu-ho meets an unexpected figure. Meanwhile, Chairwoman Lee hears of Dr. Rachel, a VVIP concierge doctor, and tails James.

videos.title: Waves on the Edge
videos.overview: Seong-woo learns Yi-rang's secret, prompting her to make a shocking announcement. Gwang-sik's return gives Chairwoman Lee one last chance.

videos.title: Mask Girl
videos.overview: A familiar woman appears before a disgraced James. Meanwhile, the trio enlists a popular influencer to help punish Gil Beauty, the queen of lawsuits.

videos.title: Mr. Gray
videos.overview: The sad tale of Un-nyun and Big Noggin is revealed. Something clicks for Gil Beauty, leading her to a village where locals share one thing in common.

videos.title: Their First Encounter
videos.overview: Ha Jung-ho is a corrupt seafood tycoon and cinephile. When he doesn't easily invest, Yi-rang comes up with a new plan—surely not a honey trap?

videos.title: Madame Oh's Heydays
videos.overview: Jung-ho agrees to invest on one condition—a full script overhaul. He wants to write, produce, direct, and act. Yi-rang's motive is finally revealed.

videos.title: The Falling Out
videos.overview: The trio drifts apart, and each carries on with their own life. Yi-rang misses James and Gu-ho, but still plots to reach Kang Yo-seop alone.

videos.title: Checkmate
videos.overview: The trio lures Yo-seop to the final feast. But Gu-ho is shot, and Yi-rang and James are captured. Who will the goddess of victory smile upon?
